display_en:
Scope and safety
Avoid this action: Use one plate or method for every age group even when it does not fit.
narration_fil: Iwasan ang ganitong kilos: Gumamit ng iisang plate o paraan sa lahat ng edad kahit hindi iyon angkop. Kung hindi tiyak ang susunod na hakbang, humingi ng gabay sa midwife o aprubadong lokal na protocol.
narration_en: Avoid this action: Use one plate or method for every age group even when it does not fit. If the next step is uncertain, consult the midwife or approved local protocol.
